description:
Delete a generated Studio artifact (audio overview, video, report, infographic, presentation, data table, flashcards, quiz) from a notebook.

Use list_content first to get the artifact id. RPC-backed (no browser).

WARNING: irreversible. Note-backed mind maps are not covered — they live in the notes system, not the Studio library.

content_id.description: The id of the artifact to delete (see list_content).

notebook_url.description: Notebook URL. If not provided, uses the active notebook.

name: content_delete

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
